notes.title: Patch 1.11: The Boogieman Cometh!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/b7906bcb7d4808f3077f1927f5c65458605fc6fd.png[/img]

[h2][u]Now Available - Boogieman (Poltergeist)
[/u][/h2]
Last June, we not only celebrated Ghostbusters Day, we celebrated the 40th Anniversary! And part of that celebration was running a contest where YOU, the community, could choose a Ghost to be part of Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed!

It was a tight match, but in the end, The Boogieman was the victor! We're happy to announce that TODAY, with the release of Patch 1.11.0, Boogieman is HERE and he's already terrifying all the innocent civvies!

Go forth and bust!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/fd3dbcf227875cb0aabb26c5a669d8b960bc4a7f.jpg[/img]
[i]There are many things that go bump in the night, but none are as infamous as the Boogieman himself! He feasts on fear and plagues children with his horrid, nightmarish visage!

Having fought the Ghostbusters on multiple occasions, he's quite experienced with their tactics and trinkets. More importantly, he's back to show just how tantalizingly terrible he can be to this new generation of Busters![/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.10.0: Double Trouble
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/aabc2e3e369ec98ea144f1adfe266ed460f2b97a.jpg[/img]
[b]Patch 1.10.0 is here,[/b] just in time for the busy season at the Firehouse! And one job in particular has got the phone ringing off the hook. Reports are coming in that the S.C.Y. County Courthouse is currently being haunted by not one, but two ghosts! Suit up, Busters, and remember to work together! As this one may require some... extra elbow grease.

[url=https://www.ghostbusterssu.com/news/patch-notes-1-10-0]Read the Patch Notes[/url] for Patch 1.10.0, or check out the highlights below!

[url=https://www.ghostbusterssu.com/news/patch-notes-1-10-0 style=button]Read the Patch Notes[/url]

[h2]New Bounty - The Scoleri Brothers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/b00ce1d54c588911e07065569070c5d489def40c.jpg[/img]
[b]The Scoleri Brothers,[/b] originally tried for murder and sentenced to the electric chair in 1948, are back with a vengeance! They're haunting the S.C.Y. County Courthouse and terrorizing innocent civilians, and it's up to you and your fellow Busters to restore order in the court! Completing this first-ever "double-Ghost" bounty will unlock Tony and Nunzio Scoleri in your Ghost roster!

[i]The Scoleri Brothers bounty is available after completing the Samhain bounty.[/i]

[h2]New Gear Shells - Zeddemore[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/26e63611d145681a3ecfbf81725577cb3580f280.jpg[/img]
Ghostbusters Headquarters went from being out of commission to being the booming operation it is today, thanks to Winston's business savvy. The innovation didn't stop with the Firehouse, as today we present to you these sleek and modern new designs for your Particle Thrower and Proton Pack!

[i]The Zeddemore Gear Shells are unlockable via contracts.[/i]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
We’re shaking up the meta! 

Tons of Ghost and Buster stats have been tweaked and changed to make gameplay feel smoother, snappier, and more rewarding. Our intentions behind this update is for both Ghosts and Busters to have a wider variety of tools and options to engage with each other. [url=https://www.ghostbusterssu.com/news/patch-notes-1-10-0]Read the Patch Notes[/url] for the full rundown of changes!

Hop into a match and give us feedback on how these changes feel to you on [url=https://discord.gg/ghostbusterssu]Discord[/url] or on our [url=https://twitter.com/GhostbustersSU]Socials[/url]!

[h2]Twitch Drops[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/950191dc13967d647ae1b541561733884cda203f.jpg[/img]
The Ghosts have been running rampant, and this special batch of Twitch Drops reflects that, as we are releasing FOUR BUNDLES of Necro Skins! That is a backlog of the first three bundles, with the brand new [b]Necropossessor Skins[/b] added!

Details and instructions [url=https://www.ghostbusterssu.com/news/twitch-drops-necro-mega-bundle-1]here[/url]!

[i]Drops active between Monday, October 21st at 10:00AM PT through Monday, November 4th at 11:59PM PT.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
A big THANK YOU to our players, and a happy haunting (or Busting) to all! We hope you enjoy our events this season, and that you'll join us in the [url=https://discord.gg/ghostbusterssu]Discord[/url] or on our [url=https://twitter.com/GhostbustersSU]Socials[/url] as we celebrate!

The Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed Team

notes.title: Patch 1.8.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/9649de9a387c61e1512a1790de1f3fc5fd37686c.png[/img]

[h2]New Overlord Variant[/h2]
[list]
[*] Garraka
[/list]
From Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire, Garraka joins the ranks of the Overlords to bring upon the death chill in Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed. To unlock Garraka, you’ll have to defeat him in an icy bounty in Galway Station!

“Spine-chilling” is a blistering understatement when describing the cold malevolence that exudes from Garraka, a formidable icy overlord. One look into his cold, soulless eyes will make you wish you never crossed paths, and that’s not even taking into account the baleful ice he can summon with his tremendous psychokinetic energy. Not even the nuclear space heaters strapped to the Ghostbusters’ backs can keep them warm for long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/f732754caa1ee3694dc0597b38da0ce881e923b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Now Replayable[/h2]
[list]
[*] Samhain Boss Fight
[/list]
You asked for it! Replay and relive your fight against eternal night. Players who have defeated Samhain will now have the option to challenge the Ghost of Halloween as many times as they’d like. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/09c0730a22104329e50ee944f39e249bf0699539.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Gear Shells[/h2]

[h3]Modern Age Gear Shells[/h3]
[list]
[*] Modern Age Proton Pack
[*] Modern Age Particle Thrower
[/list]
Ghostbusters tech is tried and true, but some fresh parts and a new coat of paint never hurts! These gear shells are unlockable via research contracts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/0c3d13d0c2e14156349a7d73e4de191ce128cd83.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Cosmetics[/h2]

[h3]Suit Tints[/h3]
[list]
[*] Frozen Outfit
[*] Lightning
[/list]
[h3]Shirt Logos[/h3]
[list]
[*] Robotics
[*] Manhattan Adventures Society
[*] GB Engineering 
[*] Garraka
[*] Frozen Neon
[*] Melody Diner
[*] Repossessed
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/0aeaecf8ff5e092653c87e1c63221b31926658ae.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes and Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Watcher Ghost Types were not available in Ghost Bounties
[*] Fixed an issue where Rifts could become untargetable after being placed in certain objects
[*] Fixed an issue where Overlords could place Catalysts on top of the whale in Whitestone Museum
[*] Fixed an issue where Overlord Types were able to place Rift Catalysts outside of bounds on certain maps
[*] Fixed an issue where turning off the setting “Software Cursor Rendering” would cause the reticle to disappear during the Possessor’s Terrorizing Possession minigame.
[*] Fixed an issue where on the Nintendo Switch, Gear and Ghost levels would display as Level 1 after re-entering the game while playing fully offline 
[*] Fixed an issue where Gravebringer’s Ossifying Lance roots VFX could float in the air if fired at a Suspended Buster
[*] Fixed an issue where Busters couldn’t move if they were clearing slime while Suspended and then struck by Gravebringer’s Ossifying Lance
[*] Fixed an issue where Busters could not free themselves if hit by Gravebringer’s Ossifying Lance while using certain emotes
[*] Fixed an issue where Gravebring could lock themselves out of their abilities if they used Ossifying Lance and Sabotaged a Buster’s pack at the same time
[*] Fixed an issue where Infernal could not use abilities after creating a Darkness Orb and sabotaging a Buster’s Proton Pack at the same time
[*] Fixed an issue where while a Buster revived their teammate, if that teammate disconnected, the Buster could lose control of their camera
[*] Fixed an issue where after watching a cinematic, the sky outside of the Firehouse would not appear correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where certain VFX would appear extremely bright after a player joins a match in-progress
[*] Fixed an issue where Wraith could Haunt objects that contained Rifts in them
[*] Fixed an issue where Poltergeists could channel their ultimate ability, Overcharge, while possessing an object
[*] Fixed an issue where the Master Collector trophy was not syncing between PS4 and PS5 accounts
[*] Fixed an issue where after equipping certain headwear or full outfits, Busters could not select Top, Bottom, and Eyewear in the customization menu
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.7.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/7dcec7b48afe6dcef01367c93b029da18edd590c.png[/img]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addressed and fixed various crashes for multiple platforms
[*] Addressed an issue that was causing users to get stuck on a loading screen while entering the Firehouse. If this still occurs to you please let us know either via socials or Discord
[*] Fixed an issue where certain contracts related to shooting ghost targets were not tracking and saving stats properly
[*] Fixed an issue where Busters could not target rifts that were inside certain destroyed objects
[*] Fixed an issue where Ghosts could not interact with rifts that were inside certain destroyed objects
[*] Fixed an issue where players names on the in-game friends list would appear as "???" if the name contained non-English characters on the Nintendo Switch
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.7.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709457/8e775f80593728531b9f93f8c8a00bd9b0037e10.png[/img]

[h2]General[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved caching to reduce stuttering and hitching for PC players 
[*] Fixed and improved localization for various languages
[*] Fixed an issue where players were seeing extremely bright VFX after joining games in progress
[*] Fixed an issue where Xbox controller prompts would sometimes appear while using a PlayStation controller on Steam
[*] Fixed an issue where a cutscene could trigger while players were in the customization menu
[*] Fixed an issue where some parts of Ray’s dialogue were missing in the Japanese version of the opening cinematic 
[*] In-game collectibles (Spores, Mold, Fungi, News Clippings and Tobin Missing Pages) should now be properly tracked when switching between Online and Offline Mode
[*] Fixed an issue where players would sometimes be incorrectly rewarded with Tobin’s Missing Pages at the end of a match
[*] Fixed an issue where certain contracts related to shooting ghost targets were not tracking properly 
[*] Fixed tracking for the “Legions” achievement while playing in Offline Mode 
[/list]

[h2]Samhain Boss fight[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where story progress could sometimes reset while switching between offline and online mode 
[*] Fixed an issue where Samhain could disappear from the boss fight if trapped during the sudden death transition 
[*] Fixed an issue where an additional Winston could appear during a cutscene
[*] Fixed an issue where Busters could use their gear during the Samhain boss fight cutscene
[*] Fixed an issue where the Graduation Day cutscene would not play properly for client players
[*] Fixed an issue where the Graduation Day cutscene would replay upon entering the Firehouse
[*] Fixed an issue where party members could appear in the background certain cutscenes 
[*] Fixed an issue where certain cinematics were missing subtitles
[/list]

[h2]Ghost Bounties[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced wait time to return to the Firehouse after completing a Ghost Bounty
[*] Slightly increased chances for Hellspawn Bounties to appear at higher player levels 
[*] Fixed an issue where canceling a Ghost Bounty during the Ready Up countdown would cause the next private match to incorrectly place the user into the previously selected Ghost Bounty
[/list]

[h2]Busters[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Busters could use the V.A.D. to escape Gravebringer’s Ossifying Lance’s root effect
[*] Fixed an issue where Busters could not open the pause menu while Suspended by an Overlord
[*] Addressed an issue where Busters would automatically switch to the Ghost Trap while trying to fire their Particle Thrower
[*] Fixed an issue where the Dual Vertical Grip attachment would sometimes automatically push or pull Ghosts
[*] Fixed an issue where the Proton Pack could appear detached from the Buster’s player model
[*] Fixed an issue where Busters could briefly see through the map after the intro cinematic on the Whitestone Museum map and Hudson Canyon Lodge map
[*] Fixed an issue where performing an emote while switching to the R.T.V. view could cause the player to become locked into the R.T.V. view
[/list]

[h2]Ghost[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Winky’s Sludge Puddle VFX
[*] Fixed an issue where Bashers could sometimes softlock Busters while sabotaging their packs 
[*] Fixed an issue where Overlords could softlock Busters by Suspending a Buster if the Buster was using the R.T.V. and had the Ecto Goggles equipped
[*] Fixed an issue where the Overlord Type variants could sometimes melee attack while tethered
[*] Fixed an issue where energy trails VFX would persist when Overlords used Suspend while sabotaging 
[*] Fixed an issue where Overlord Suspend ability VFX would sometimes be displayed abnormally
[*] Fixed an issue where Ghosts could exit map bounds while being trapped 
[*] Fixed an issue where Ghosts could become untrappable and instantly drain trap batteries 
[*] Fixed an issue where Poltergeists were not regenerating extra energy while possessing electronic type possessables
[*] Fixed an issue where Possessor variants could not properly move through train doors in the Galway Station map
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]Bot Improvements and Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various improvements and fixes to Buster bot’s mantling
[*] Glutton bots will now use their unique and ultimate abilities more often
[*] Fixed an issue where Buster bots in the Firehouse would sometimes float above the ground
[*] Fixed an issue where Buster bots would try to calm civilians while affected by the Overlord’s Suspend status effect
[*] Fixed an issue where Buster bots were not using custom loadouts in the Samhain boss fight 
[*] Fixed an issue where Overlord bots would not move if they spawned at certain locations in the MOROS Medical Facility map
[*] Fixed an issue where Buster bots would stop moving after supporting a horrified civilian
[*] Fixed an issue where Buster bots could get stuck after using the V.A.D. at certain locations in the Clock Tower Brewery map
[/list]
